results.name: Both plugins enable independently and report their own model readiness
Cancel terminates actual BiRefNet inference and permits retry
Cutout workspace blocks native mode changes and keeps source edits unchanged
Real BiRefNet runs offline under production CSP and produces a soft transparent subject
Original/cutout comparison and preview backdrops never flatten the canvas
Manual correction, keyboard Undo/Redo and reset are deterministic
A failed collection restore keeps the preview and retries the same durable variant
Cutout PNG/project persist alpha, source dimensions, edge settings and model provenance
Saved cutout reopens after restart with its plugin disabled and LaMa still enabled
